name: settimeofday
synopsis: int settimeofday(const struct timeval *tv, const struct timezone *_Nullable tz);
description: The settimeofday() function sets the system's time and optionally the timezone. It takes a pointer to a struct timeval for the new time in seconds and microseconds since the Epoch, and a pointer to a struct timezone if needed.

parameters.name: tv
parameters.description: Pointer to a struct timeval containing the new time (seconds and microseconds since the Epoch)

parameters.name: tz
parameters.description: Pointer to a struct timezone, or NULL to not set the timezone; the use of this structure is obsolete

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set to indicate the error

errors.description: One of tv or tz pointed outside the accessible address space
tv.tv_sec is negative or tv.tv_usec is outside the range [0,999,999]
Since Linux 4.3: Attempt to set the time to a value less than the current value of the CLOCK_MONOTONIC clock
The calling process has insufficient privilege; under Linux, the CAP_SYS_TIME capability is required
